description: Rank HS chapters (2-digit) or headings (4-digit) by trade value for one reporter, flow, and annual or monthly period. Retrieves matching TOTAL and the reporter’s HS edition, then queries explicit commodity codes in chunks; capped chunks are subdivided. Shares use matching TOTAL. Incomplete coverage returns available categories without ranks or shares and identifies unresolved codes. Defaults to World; optionally select one bilateral partner. Counterpart to comtrade_get_top_partners.

aggr_level.description: HS aggregation level: 2 = chapter (broader), 4 = heading (more specific).

limit.description: Number of top commodity categories to return; totalCommodities counts every category retrieved.

partner_code.description: M49 partner code (0–999) for a bilateral relationship; omit for World aggregate (0).

period.description: Single period: annual (YYYY) or monthly (YYYYMM, month 01–12).

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country (0–999).

name: comtrade_get_top_commodities

classificationCode.description: HS edition identified by matching TOTAL.

commodities.description: Top commodity categories sorted by descending trade value.

primaryValueUsd.description: Trade value in USD (FOB for exports, CIF for imports).

rank.description: Rank (1 = largest trade value), only with complete code coverage and known values.

sharePercent.description: Share of matching TOTAL trade value, only with complete code coverage.

coverageComplete.description: Whether every code in the matching HS edition was queried without a capped response.

coverageNotice.description: Explanation of coverage and ranking availability.

denominatorValueUsd.description: Matching TOTAL value used as the share denominator, separate from the retrieved-category sum.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `keyless_hs_edition_unsupported`: An explicit HS edition requires authenticated access. `upstream_validation`: UN Comtrade rejects the supplied query dimensions. `invalid_upstream_response`: UN Comtrade returns a malformed response. `invalid_reporter_filter`: The query omits required reporter filtering. `rate_limited`: With TOTAL or the HS reference unavailable, UN Comtrade rate-limited the aggregate fallback through its retries. `deadline_exceeded`: With TOTAL or the HS reference unavailable, the aggregate fallback did not complete within the call's time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

missingCodes.description: Codes whose retrieval failed, remained capped, or did not fit the call's time budget; empty when the code universe is unavailable.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no data is returned.

totalCommodities.description: Total commodity categories returned by API.

totalValueUsd.description: Sum of primary values across all returned categories (before limit).

truncated.description: True when complete commodity-code coverage could not be established.

title: Get Top Trade Commodities
